phrases.text: In twenty-sixteen, Sweden got its own phone number.
Call it from anywhere in the world
and a random Swede picks up.
No script.
No instructions.
Just a stranger, saying "hej".
Suggested topics?
Meatballs.
Darkness.
Feminism.
People called from one hundred and eighty-six countries.
Nearly two hundred thousand calls, day and night.
Add them all up,
and the world talked to Sweden for three hundred and seventy-six days.
The longest call lasted four hours
and forty-two minutes.
That's longer than most movies.
Maybe that wasn't really about meatballs.
Maybe someone just needed a person to pick up.
Most of us don't have a whole country on speed dial.
That's why we made Feeloy.
Jenny always picks up, remembers what you told her,
and never runs out of time to talk.
Search Feeloy on the App Store.
